Unlike utilization paper, use the seer time of diagnosis mets variable. The utilization paper actually used a claims derived mets site, which could introduce immortal time bias in the safety paper since the claims based was defined over the course of follow-up? double check -- may have just put a time restriction.

```{r}
table(data2$SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010, useNA = "always")
# =============================================================================
# SEER-derived visceral metastasis variables for IPTW PS model
# Variable interpretation: count of major visceral sites (brain/bone/liver/lung)
# Note: All patients are stage IV by definition, so n=0 means primary mets
# are at sites other than the four SEER-coded visceral organs
# =============================================================================

summary(data2$sex_recode)
# Step 1: Create site-specific binary indicators with explicit NA handling
# SEER codes: 0 = No, 1 = Yes, 9 = Unknown, NA = Not coded
# Treat 9 and NA together as "Unknown" — do NOT silently assume "No"


data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    seer_brain = case_when( # AZ audit 08122026: matches codebook
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_BRAIN_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    seer_bone = case_when( # AZ audit 08122026: matches codebook
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_BONE_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_BONE_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                   ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    seer_liver = case_when( # AZ audit 08122026: matches codebook
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_LIVER_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSATDX_LIVER_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    seer_lung = case_when( # AZ audit 08122026: matches codebook
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_LUNG_2010) == "0" ~ "No",
      as.character(SEERCOMBINEDMETSAT_DX_LUNG_2010) == "1" ~ "Yes",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(seer_brain, seer_bone, seer_liver, seer_lung),
                ~ factor(., levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))))

# QC: confirm site-level distributions
cat("\n=== Site-specific SEER metastasis distributions ===\n")
table(data2$seer_brain, useNA = "always")
table(data2$seer_bone,  useNA = "always")
table(data2$seer_liver, useNA = "always")
table(data2$seer_lung,  useNA = "always")

# Step 2: Count confirmed visceral metastatic sites
# Range: 0-4. Count is "number of visceral organs with confirmed metastasis."
# Sites coded Unknown contribute 0 to the count but are tracked separately.
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    seer_brain_bin = as.integer(seer_brain == "Yes"),
    seer_bone_bin  = as.integer(seer_bone  == "Yes"),
    seer_liver_bin = as.integer(seer_liver == "Yes"),
    seer_lung_bin  = as.integer(seer_lung  == "Yes"),
    
    n_visceral_mets = seer_brain_bin + seer_bone_bin + seer_liver_bin + seer_lung_bin,
    
    n_unknown_sites = (seer_brain == "Unknown") +
                      (seer_bone  == "Unknown") +
                      (seer_liver == "Unknown") +
                      (seer_lung  == "Unknown")
  )

cat("\n=== Confirmed visceral mets count by exposure ===\n")
table(data2$n_visceral_mets, data2$exposure_arm, useNA = "always")

cat("\n=== Distribution of sites with unknown status ===\n")
table(data2$n_unknown_sites, useNA = "always")

# Step 3: Define a categorical version interpreting n=0 as "non-visceral primary"
# Note the explicit labeling — patients with 0 confirmed visceral sites do have
# stage IV disease, but their metastatic site is not one of the four SEER-coded organs
# AZ audit 08122026: I don't totally follow. Txted Soph
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    visceral_mets_cat = case_when(
      n_visceral_mets == 0 & n_unknown_sites == 0 ~ "Non-visceral Mets Site",
      n_visceral_mets == 0 & n_unknown_sites > 0  ~ "Indeterminate",
      n_visceral_mets == 1                        ~ "1 visceral site",
      n_visceral_mets == 2                        ~ "2 visceral sites",
      n_visceral_mets >= 3                        ~ "3+ visceral sites"
    ),
    visceral_mets_cat = factor(visceral_mets_cat,
                               levels = c("Non-visceral Mets Site",
                                          "1 visceral site",
                                          "2 visceral sites",
                                          "3+ visceral sites",
                                          "Indeterminate"))
  )

cat("\n=== visceral_mets_cat by exposure ===\n")
table(data2$visceral_mets_cat, data2$exposure_arm, useNA = "always")

# Step 4: Prepare for PS model with missing-indicator approach
# Continuous version for interactions, with explicit flag for indeterminate patients
# AZ audit 08122026: one row per pt
length(unique(data2$PATIENT_ID)) == nrow(data2)
cohort_median_visceral <- median(data2$n_visceral_mets[
  data2$visceral_mets_cat != "Indeterminate"
], na.rm = TRUE)


data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    # AZ audit 08122026: using median for pts with missing
    # Continuous variable for PS interactions
    n_visceral_mets_cont = ifelse(visceral_mets_cat == "Indeterminate",
                                   cohort_median_visceral,
                                   n_visceral_mets),
    
    # Missing-indicator flag for indeterminate status
    indeterminate_mets = as.integer(visceral_mets_cat == "Indeterminate")
  )

cat("\n=== Imputxation verification ===\n")
cat("Cohort median visceral mets:", cohort_median_visceral, "\n")
cat("n with indeterminate flag:", sum(data2$indeterminate_mets), "\n")
table(data2$n_visceral_mets_cont, data2$indeterminate_mets, useNA = "always")


```

```{r}
data <- data2

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE VARIABLE TYPES
# =============================================================================

cat_vars <- c("sex_recode", "race_binary", "radiation_binary", "yost_tertile",
  "pre_ici_surg", "charlson_recode", "autoimmune_recode", "braf_recode", 
  "firstline_ici_recode", "histo_C", "primary_site_group",
  "seer_brain", "visceral_mets_cat"
)

cont_vars <- c("days_dx_to_tx", "AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100",
               "n_visceral_mets_cont", "indeterminate_mets")

# All covariates for PS model
all_covariates <- c(cat_vars, cont_vars)
# =============================================================================
# DIAGNOSE: Find factors with <2 levels
# =============================================================================

cat("--- Checking factor levels ---\n")
for (var in cat_vars) {
  n_levels <- length(unique(na.omit(data[[var]])))
  cat(var, ":", n_levels, "levels\n")
  if (n_levels < 2) {
    cat("  *** PROBLEM: Only 1 level! ***\n")
    print(table(data[[var]], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
}

```
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR PSM
# =============================================================================

data_ps <- data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cat_vars), as.factor))

data_ps <- data_ps %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cont_vars), as.numeric))

data_ps <- data_ps %>%
  mutate(
    dual = case_when(
      exposure_arm == "Dual (PD-1 + CTLA-4) ICI therapy" ~ 1,
      exposure_arm == "Single (PD-1 or CTLA-4) ICI therapy" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

cat("--- Treatment Distribution ---\n")
table(data_ps$dual, data_ps$exposure_arm, useNA = "ifany")

cat("\n--- Variable Types ---\n")
data_ps %>%
  select(all_of(all_covariates)) %>%
  sapply(class) %>%
  print()

cat("\n--- Missingness ---\n")
data_ps %>%
  select(all_of(all_covariates), dual) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0) %>%
  print()

# =============================================================================
# DROP MISSING BEFORE PSM
# =============================================================================

cat("N before dropping missing:", nrow(data_ps), "\n")

data_ps_complete <- data_ps %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(charlson_recode),
    !is.na(autoimmune_recode),
    !is.na(primary_site_group)
  )

# AZ audit 08/14/2026: could handle this other ways since have small sample but not a big issue
cat("N after dropping missing:", nrow(data_ps_complete), "\n")
cat("Dropped:", nrow(data_ps) - nrow(data_ps_complete), "patients\n")

data_ps_complete %>%
  select(all_of(all_covariates), dual) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0)

cat("\n--- Treatment Distribution (Complete Cases) ---\n")
table(data_ps_complete$dual, useNA = "ifany")
```
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PROPENSITY SCORE MODEL
# =============================================================================

# Note: visceral_mets_cat and n_visceral_mets_cont are collinear by design.
# Use the categorical version OR the continuous + indeterminate flag, not both.
# Here we use the continuous + indeterminate flag for the burden gradient,
# and drop the categorical from the PS formula to avoid singularity.

ps_covariates <- c(setdiff(all_covariates, "visceral_mets_cat"))

ps_formula <- as.formula(paste(
  "dual ~",
  paste(ps_covariates, collapse = " + "),
  "+ AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100:n_visceral_mets_cont",
  "+ sex_recode:n_visceral_mets_cont"
))

cat("\n--- PS Model Formula ---\n")
print(ps_formula)

ps_model <- glm(
  ps_formula,
  data = data_ps_complete,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

if (!ps_model$converged) {
  warning("Model did not converge!")
}

data_ps_complete <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(ps = predict(ps_model, type = "response"))
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE IPTW WEIGHTS
# =============================================================================

pbar <- mean(data_ps_complete$dual, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nPrevalence of Dual therapy:", round(pbar, 4), "\n")

data_ps_complete <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(
    uw = ifelse(dual == 1, 1 / ps, 1 / (1 - ps)),
    sw = ifelse(dual == 1, pbar / ps, (1 - pbar) / (1 - ps))
  )

# Trim weights at 1st and 99th percentile
sw_p1 <- quantile(data_ps_complete$sw, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
sw_p99 <- quantile(data_ps_complete$sw, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nTrimming thresholds:\n")
cat("  1st percentile:", round(sw_p1, 4), "\n")
cat("  99th percentile:", round(sw_p99, 4), "\n")
# AZ audit 08/12/2026: not sure you need to truncate
data_ps_complete <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(
    sw_t = pmax(pmin(sw, sw_p99), sw_p1)
  )

cat("\n--- Weight Summary by Treatment Group ---\n")
data_ps_complete %>%
  group_by(dual) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ps = round(mean(ps, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    mean_sw = round(mean(sw, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    mean_sw_t = round(mean(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    min_sw_t = round(min(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    max_sw_t = round(max(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nOverall mean of trimmed stabilized weights:", 
    round(mean(data_ps_complete$sw_t, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "(should be ~1)\n")
```

```{r}
love.plot(
```

Weighted table one
```{r}


# Unweighted
tab_unw <- CreateTableOne(
  vars = all_covariates,
  strata = "dual",
  data = data_ps_complete,
  test = FALSE,
  smd = TRUE
)

# Weighted
# AZ audit 08122026: reformat table
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Get weighted ASMDs from tableone
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tab_smd <- svyCreateTableOne(
  vars = all_covariates,
  strata = "dual",
  data = design_wt,
  test = FALSE,
  smd = TRUE
)

smd_df <- ExtractSmd(tab_smd) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variable")

# With 2 treatment groups, there is one SMD column
names(smd_df)[2] <- "ASMD"

smd_df <- smd_df |>
  dplyr::select(variable, ASMD)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create weighted descriptive table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tab_wt <- tbl_svysummary(
  data = design_wt,
  by = dual,
  include = all_of(all_covariates),

  label = list(
    sex_recode ~ "Male",
    race_binary ~ "White",
    radiation_binary ~ "Radiation",
    yost_tertile ~ "Yost SES tertile",
    pre_ici_surg ~ "Pre-ICI surgery",
    charlson_recode ~ "Charlson comorbidity score",
    autoimmune_recode ~ "Autoimmune disease",
    braf_recode ~ "Targeted therapy (BRAF or MEKi)",
    firstline_ici_recode ~ "Systemic anticancer therapy sequence",
    histo_C ~ "Histology",
    primary_site_group ~ "Primary site",
    seer_brain ~ "Brain metastases",
    visceral_mets_cat ~ "Visceral metastases",
    days_dx_to_tx ~ "Time from diagnosis to treatment, days",
    AGERECODEWITHSINGLEAGES_AND_100 ~ "Age (years)",
    n_visceral_mets_cont ~ "Number of visceral metastases",
    indeterminate_mets ~ "Indeterminate metastases"
  ),

  type = list(
    sex_recode ~ "dichotomous",
    race_binary ~ "dichotomous"
  ),

  value = list(
    sex_recode ~ "Male",
    race_binary ~ "White"
  ),

  statistic = list(
    all_categorical() ~ "{p}%",
    all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"
  ),

  digits = list(
    all_categorical() ~ 1,
    all_continuous() ~ 1
  ),

  percent = "column"
) |>

  # Join ASMDs from tableone
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x |>
      dplyr::left_join(smd_df, by = "variable") |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        ASMD = dplyr::if_else(
          row_type == "label",
          ASMD,
          NA_real_
        )
      )
  ) |>

  modify_header(
    stat_1 ~ "**Single ICI**",
    stat_2 ~ "**Dual ICI**",
    ASMD ~ "**ASMD**"
  ) |>

  modify_fmt_fun(
    ASMD ~ label_style_number(digits = 2)
  ) |>

  remove_footnote_header(
    columns = all_stat_cols()
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create clean table to copy to Excel/PowerPoint
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ppt_tab <- tab_wt$table_body |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(label)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Characteristic = ifelse(
      row_type == "level",
      paste0("   ", label),
      label
    ),
    `Single ICI` = stat_1,
    `Dual ICI` = stat_2,
    ASMD = ifelse(
      is.na(ASMD),
      "",
      sprintf("%.2f", ASMD)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Copy to clipboard
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ppt_tab |>
  write_clip()

smd_col <- setdiff(names(smd_df), "variable")[1]

poor_balance <- smd_df[
  !is.na(smd_df[[smd_col]]) &
    abs(smd_df[[smd_col]]) >= 0.1,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(poor_balance) > 0) {
  cat("\n--- Covariates with |SMD| >= 0.1 after weighting ---\n")
  print(poor_balance)
} else {
  cat("\n--- All covariates balanced (|SMD| < 0.1) after weighting ---\n")
}

# SAVE
# =============================================================================

saveRDS(data_ps_complete, "../Data/processed/skin_ici_psweighted.rds")
```

```{r}
# Weighted KM: Single vs Dual, time expressed in months
fit_wt_arm <- survfit(
  Surv(years_to_end_followup1_d * 12, censor_flag_11) ~ exposure_arm,
  data = data_ps_complete,
  weights = sw_t
)

# Dynamic labels
arm_labs <- names(fit_wt_arm$strata)
arm_labs <- sub("^exposure_arm=", "", arm_labs)
arm_labs <- sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", arm_labs)
arm_labs <- trimws(arm_labs)
# AZ audit 08142026: poster-sized weighted KM plot

km_plot_arm <- ggsurvplot(
  fit = fit_wt_arm,
  data = data_ps_complete,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  palette = "lancet",
  linetype = 1,

  # AZ audit 08142026: increase line and censor sizes for poster
  size = 1.8,
  censor.size = 4,

  # AZ audit 08142026: cap at 2.5 years (30 months);
  # show weighted N at risk every 6 months
  xlim = c(0, 30),
  break.time.by = 6,

  title = "", # AZ audit 08142026: no title for poster
  xlab = "Time since ICI index date (months)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.title = "ICI Arm",
  legend.labs = arm_labs,

  risk.table.title = "Weighted N at Risk",
  risk.table.fontsize = 6,
  risk.table.height = 0.30,

  conf.int = FALSE,
  pval = FALSE,

  # AZ audit 08142026: increase overall font size
```

```{r}

# --- Derived variables --------------------------------------------------------
d_ps <- data_ps_complete %>%
  mutate(
    months_to_end_fu2 = years_to_end_followup2 * 12,
    log_fu2 = log(years_to_end_followup2),
    sw_t_norm = sw_t / mean(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    exposure_arm_f = factor(exposure_arm)
  )

mean(data_ps_complete$sw_t, na.rm = TRUE)      
mean(data_ps_complete$sw_t_norm, na.rm = TRUE) 

#===============================================================================
# SECTION 1: DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
#===============================================================================

# Cross-tabulation: exposure_arm by event status
table(d_ps$exposure_arm, d_ps$censor_flag2)
prop.table(table(d_ps$exposure_arm, d_ps$censor_flag2), margin = 1) %>% round(4)

# AZ audit 08142026: get all N's
d_ps %>%
  group_by(exposure_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    actual_n = n(),
    weighted_n = sum(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    effective_n = sum(sw_t, na.rm = TRUE)^2 /
      sum(sw_t^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Follow-up duration by exposure arm
d_ps %>%
  mutate(days_fu = years_to_end_followup2*365) %>%
  group_by(exposure_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    
    # Unweighted summaries
    mean_years = mean(days_fu, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25 = quantile(days_fu, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p50 = quantile(days_fu, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75 = quantile(days_fu, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(days_fu, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(days_fu, na.rm = TRUE),

    # AZ audit 08142026: IPTW-weighted summaries
    wt_mean_yrs = weighted.mean(
      days_fu,
      w = sw_t,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    wt_p25 = as.numeric(Hmisc::wtd.quantile(
      days_fu,
      weights = sw_t,
      probs = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    wt_p50 = as.numeric(Hmisc::wtd.quantile(
      days_fu,
      weights = sw_t,
      probs = 0.50,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    wt_p75 = as.numeric(Hmisc::wtd.quantile(
      days_fu,
      weights = sw_t,
      probs = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check for negative follow-up
d_ps %>% filter(years_to_end_followup2 < 0)
```

Safety CI continued -- Aalen Johansen accounting for competing risk
```{r}
# SK 0816: adding weighted CIF estimates at defined cut-offs

table(d_ps$exposure_arm)
#make event factor
d_ps$censor_flag2 <- factor(d_ps$censor_flag2, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                    labels = c("censor", "severe_irAE", "death"))
summary(d_ps$years_to_end_followup2)
fit <- survfit(Surv(years_to_end_followup2, censor_flag2) ~ exposure_arm,
               data = d_ps, weights = sw_t_norm, id = PATIENT_ID)

summary(fit, times = c(0.0821, 0.164, 0.2465))  # weighted CIF at landmarks
plot(fit)  # or ggsurvfit/ggcompetingrisks for publication figures

# SK 0816: pull CIF + 95% CI for severe irAE, and RD between arms

landmarks <- c(0.0821, 0.164, 0.2465)   # ~30, 60, 90 days
s <- summary(fit, times = landmarks, extend = TRUE)
col_irae <- which(colnames(s$pstate) == "severe_irAE")

cif_tab <- data.frame(
  arm  = rep(levels(d_ps$exposure_arm), each = length(landmarks)),
  time = s$time,
  cif  = s$pstate[, col_irae],
  se   = s$std.err[, col_irae],
  lcl  = s$lower[, col_irae],
  ucl  = s$upper[, col_irae]
)

# short labels so pivot_wider gives clean column names
cif_tab$arm_short <- ifelse(grepl("^Dual", cif_tab$arm), "dual", "single")

# ---- risk difference: dual minus single, per landmark ----
z <- qnorm(0.975)

rd_tab <- cif_tab %>%
  select(arm_short, time, cif, se) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = arm_short, values_from = c(cif, se)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd     = cif_dual - cif_single,
    rd_se  = sqrt(se_dual^2 + se_single^2),
    rd_lcl = rd - z * rd_se,
    rd_ucl = rd + z * rd_se,
    rd_fmt = sprintf("%.1f pp (%.1f–%.1f)",
                     100 * rd, 100 * rd_lcl, 100 * rd_ucl)
  )

rd_tab[, c("time", "rd_fmt")]
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ============================================================
# Extract severe irAE AJ CIF
# ============================================================

s <- summary(fit)

plot_dat <- data.frame(
  time_years = s$time,
  strata = s$strata
)

  plot_dat,
  as.data.frame(s$pstate)
)

irae_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  mutate(
    time_days = time_years * 365.25,
    arm = gsub("^exposure_arm=", "", strata)
  ) %>%
  select(time_days, arm, severe_irAE)

max_cif <- max(irae_dat$severe_irAE, na.rm = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 90-day induction-period zoom
# ============================================================

  subset(irae_dat, time_days <= 90),

    x = time_days,
    y = severe_irAE,
    colour = arm
  )
) +
  annotate(
  "label",

  hjust = 0,

"Risk Difference
30 d:  +6.3%
(-0.9, 13.4)

90 d:  +7.5%

180 d: +10.1%
(1.3, 18.9)"
) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1.6) +
```

Cleaned code chunk for fine gray + schoenfeld residuals
```{r}
#===============================================================================
# SECTION 3: FINE-GRAY SUBDISTRIBUTION HAZARD MODELS
# Severe irAE (event = 1) with death as competing risk
#===============================================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

#===============================================================================
# Fine-Gray expanded dataset
#===============================================================================

fg_data <- finegray(
  Surv(
    years_to_end_followup2,
    factor(censor_flag2)
  ) ~ .,
  data = d_ps %>%
    select(
      PATIENT_ID,
      years_to_end_followup2,
      censor_flag2,
      exposure_arm,
      sw_t_norm,
      age_75_binary,
      visceral_mets_cat,
      seer_brain,
      pre_ici_surg
    ),
  etype = "severe_irAE" 
)

# Combine Fine-Gray weights with IPTW weights

fg_data <- fg_data %>%
  mutate(
    combined_wt = fgwt * sw_t_norm
  )

#===============================================================================
# Helper function
#===============================================================================

print_fg_results <- function(model, label){

  beta <- coef(model)[1]

  hr <- exp(beta)

  ci <- exp(confint(model))[1, ]

  p <- summary(model)$coefficients[
    1,
    "Pr(>|z|)"
  ]

  cat("\n=================================================\n")
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat("=================================================\n")

  cat(
    sprintf(
      "sHR = %.3f (95%% CI %.3f - %.3f), p = %.4f\n",
      hr,
      ci[1],
      ci[2],
      p
    )
  )
}

#===============================================================================
# Overall IPTW Fine-Gray model
#===============================================================================

fg_iptw <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data,
  weights = combined_wt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)

print_fg_results(
  fg_iptw,
  "Overall IPTW Fine-Gray Model"
)

#===============================================================================
# 90-Day IPTW Fine-Gray model
#===============================================================================

horizon_90d <- 90 / 365.25

fg_data_90d <- fg_data %>%
  mutate(
    fgstop_90d = pmin(fgstop, horizon_90d),

    fgstatus_90d =
      ifelse(
        fgstop <= horizon_90d,
        fgstatus,
        0
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(fgstop_90d > fgstart)

fg_iptw_90d <- coxph(
  Surv(
    fgstart,
    fgstop_90d,
    fgstatus_90d
  ) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data_90d,
  weights = combined_wt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)

print_fg_results(
  fg_iptw_90d,
  "IPTW Fine-Gray Model: First 90 Days"
)

#===============================================================================
# 12-Month IPTW Fine-Gray model
#===============================================================================

fg_data_12m <- fg_data %>%
  mutate(
    fgstop_12m = pmin(fgstop, 1),

    fgstatus_12m =
      ifelse(
        fgstop <= 1,
        fgstatus,
        0
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(fgstop_12m > fgstart)

fg_iptw_12m <- coxph(
  Surv(
    fgstart,
    fgstop_12m,
    fgstatus_12m
  ) ~ factor(exposure_arm),
  data = fg_data_12m,
  weights = combined_wt,
  id = PATIENT_ID,
  robust = TRUE
)

print_fg_results(
  fg_iptw_12m,
  "IPTW Fine-Gray Model: First 12 Months"
)

#===============================================================================
# Proportional Hazards Diagnostics
#===============================================================================

cat("\n\n")
cat("=================================================\n")
cat("PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("=================================================\n")

# Overall model
ph_overall <- cox.zph(fg_iptw)

cat("\n--- Overall Model ---\n")
print(ph_overall)

plot(
  ph_overall,
  main = "Overall Fine-Gray PH Diagnostics"
)

# 90-day model
ph_90d <- cox.zph(fg_iptw_90d)

cat("\n--- 90-Day Model ---\n")
print(ph_90d)

plot(
  ph_90d,
  main = "90-Day Fine-Gray PH Diagnostics"
)

# 12-month model
ph_12m <- cox.zph(fg_iptw_12m)

cat("\n--- 12-Month Model ---\n")
print(ph_12m)

plot(
  ph_12m,
  main = "12-Month Fine-Gray PH Diagnostics"
)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# FIGURE 1
# Benchmarking Severe Immunotherapy Toxicity
# Across Clinical Trial and Medicare Cohorts
# ==========================================================



lv <- c(
  "CheckMate 067",
  "RELATIVITY-047",
  "SEER-Medicare"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Top panel
# ----------------------------------------------------------

ae <- tribble(
  ~cohort,          ~regimen,        ~pct, ~ph,

  "CheckMate 067",  "Single-agent", 16.0, FALSE,
  "CheckMate 067",  "Dual-agent",   55.0, FALSE,

  "RELATIVITY-047", "Single-agent",  9.7, FALSE,
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Dual-agent",   18.9, FALSE,

  "SEER-Medicare",  "Single-agent",  9.9, TRUE,
  "SEER-Medicare",  "Dual-agent",   20.0, TRUE
) |>
  mutate(
    cohort  = factor(cohort, lv),
    regimen = factor(regimen,
                     c("Single-agent","Dual-agent")),
    lab     = sprintf("%.1f", pct)
  )

# Absolute risk difference

fold <- ae |>
  select(cohort, regimen, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = regimen,
    values_from = pct
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rd  = `Dual-agent` - `Single-agent`,
    lab = paste0("+", round(rd), " pp"),
    y   = pmax(
      `Dual-agent`,
      `Single-agent`
    ) + c(8, 8, 13)
  )

pA <-

  ggplot(
    ae,
    aes(
      cohort,
      pct,
      fill = regimen
    )
  ) +

  # highlight Medicare cohort
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 2.55,
    xmax = 3.45,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#F2E5B5"
  ) +

  geom_col(
    aes(linetype = ph),
    position = position_dodge(0.72),
    width = 0.62,
    colour = navy,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = lab),
    position = position_dodge(0.72),
    vjust = -0.55,
    size = 3.8,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = fold,
    aes(
      cohort,
      y,
      label = lab
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = navy,
    size = 4.3
  ) +
scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Single-agent" = single_col,
    "Dual-agent"   = dual_col
  )
) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      `FALSE` = "solid",
      `TRUE`  = "22"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    "Severe toxicity (%)",
    limits = c(0,70),
    breaks = seq(0,60,20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0,0))
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Benchmarking Severe Immunotherapy Toxicity",
      "Across Clinical Trial and Medicare Cohorts",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    plot.title =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 15,
        colour = "black",
        hjust = 0
      ),

    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.margin = margin(b = -4),
    legend.key.size = unit(9, "pt"),

    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x  = element_blank(),

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        colour = "black",
        size = 14
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 11
      ),

    plot.margin =
      margin(
        6, 12, 2, 6
      )
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Bottom comparison table
# ----------------------------------------------------------

rows <- rev(c(
  "Median age",
  "Age ≥75",
  "Brain metastases",
  "Autoimmune disease",
  "Treatment comparison"
))

pop <- tribble(
  ~cohort,          ~item,                  ~value,

  "CheckMate 067",  "Median age",           "62",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Age ≥75",              "Rare",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Brain metastases",     "Excluded",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Autoimmune disease",   "Excluded",
  "CheckMate 067",  "Treatment comparison", "Nivo vs\nNivo+Ipi",

  "RELATIVITY-047", "Median age",           "63",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Age ≥75",              "Rare",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Brain metastases",     "Active\nexcluded",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Autoimmune disease",   "Excluded",
  "RELATIVITY-047", "Treatment comparison", "Nivo vs\nNivo+Rela",

  "SEER-Medicare",  "Median age",           "75",
  "SEER-Medicare",  "Age ≥75",              "49%",
  "SEER-Medicare",  "Brain metastases",     "12%",
  "SEER-Medicare",  "Autoimmune disease",   "14%",
  "SEER-Medicare",  "Treatment comparison", "Nivo/Ipi/Pembro vs\nNivo+Ipi"
) |>
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(cohort, lv),
    item   = factor(item, rows),
    col    = "black"
  )

pB <-

  ggplot(
    pop,
    aes(
      cohort,
      item
    )
  ) +

  geom_tile(
    aes(
      fill = cohort == "SEER-Medicare"
    ),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = value,
      colour = col
    ),
    size = 3.25,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      `FALSE` = "#EDF2F9",
      `TRUE`  = "#F2E5B5"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  scale_colour_identity() +

  scale_x_discrete(
    position = "bottom",
    expand = expansion(0)
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(0)
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x =
      element_text(
        face = "bold",
        colour = "black",
        size = 10,
        margin = margin(t = 4)
      ),

    axis.text.y =
      element_text(
        hjust = 1,
        face = "bold",
        colour = "black",
        size = 10
      ),

    plot.margin =
      margin(
        2, 12, 6, 6
      )
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Combine figure
# ----------------------------------------------------------

fig <-

  pA / pB +

  plot_layout(
    heights = c(
      2.3,
      1
    )
  ) +

  plot_annotation(
    caption =
      paste(
        "CheckMate-067 and RELATIVITY-047: grade 3–4 treatment-related adverse events.",
        "SEER-Medicare: 180-day IPTW-weighted Aalen–Johansen cumulative incidence of severe irAE;",
        "death treated as a competing risk."
      ),

    theme =
      theme(
        plot.caption =
          element_text(
            hjust = 0,
            size = 8,
            colour = "black",
            margin = margin(t = 6)
          ),

        plot.margin =
          margin(
            4, 6, 4, 6
          )
      )
  )

print(fig)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure1_Toxicity_Benchmark.png",
  plot = fig,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 5.4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
